controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T19:02:22.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T20:02:22.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
| KEEP @timestamp, falco.rule, falco.output_fields.proc.name, falco.output_fields.proc.pname, falco.output_fields.proc.cmdline, falco.output_fields.user.name, falco.output_fields.container.name, falco.output_fields.container.id
| SORT @timestamp ASC
